messages:
alex_m: Heads-up — we’re seeing a bunch of GPU jobs OOM / stuck in Creating on racks 12-14. Control-plane logs show connections to lb-internal-us-west timing out. Any recent infra changes?

priya_r: Not that I know of from infra side, but infra CI pushed kernel 6.1.0-rc to the rack nodes earlier this morning. Saw a small bump in intra-rack latency around 09:05.

sam_g: I captured a short tcpdump on a pod-facing interface. Lots of SYNs stuck in SYN_RECV to the ToR mgmt IP. Snippet:```
$ sudo tcpdump -nni eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn) != 0' -c 20
12:10:12.123456 IP 10.120.12.45.52344 > 10.120.12.1.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, length 0
12:10:12.123789 IP 10.120.12.46.52344 > 10.120.12.1.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, length 0
```
These SYNs never progress to ESTABLISHED, then we see resets after conntrack expiry.

oncall-bot: Created INC-2026-0123: tor-holdopen-synq-backpressure. Pager duty paged to eng-infra.

cheng_w: That pattern screams SYN queue exhaustion on the ToR (hold-open behavior). Could be caused by L4 proxying + kernel change altering SYN_RECV handling. Any conntrack counts?

alex_m: netstat shows many sockets in SYN_RECV on the ToR-facing nodes:```
$ sudo ss -s
TCP:   584 (estab 230, closed 120, orphaned 0, synrecv 320, timewait 14/0),
```
synrecv is ~320 which is higher than normal (~<50).

priya_r: Also noticed jumbo frame handling looks inconsistent after the kernel bump. Some hosts had MTU 9000, others negotiated 8982 on the ToR. Could be fragmentation + SYN reordering causing backpressure.

sam_g: I tried toggling GRO/LRO on one node to see if it affects behavior:```
sudo ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off
```
After disabling, that node recovered connections to lb-internal-us-west and GPU jobs started pulling images again.

cheng_w: Good test. That points to NIC offloads interacting badly with ToR firmware/kernel path. Two parallel mitigations: 1) rollback kernel on impacted racks or 2) disable offloads cluster-wide while we triage. Neither ideal.

alex_m: Short-term we need capacity for running customer jobs. Options: move LB traffic away from those ToRs (pinhole to upstream spine), or migrate affected GPU pods to healthy racks. Which is faster?

priya_r: We can adjust LB-internal to avoid ToR forwarding via stickyhash->source-ip routing so traffic goes direct to other racks. I can flip a route-map but it will cause some cache churn.

sam_g: I can cordon and drain GPUs from racks 12-14 and reschedule to racks 3-5 (has 20% spare). Will take ~12-18m for eviction + image pulls.

cheng_w: Meanwhile I'll open a support case with ToR vendor about hold-open SYN handling after the kernel change and gather firmware logs (BFD flaps?) Also collect `ethtool -k` and `dmesg` from impacted nodes.

alex_m: Plan: (1) sam cordons/drains affected nodes (2) priya toggles LB to route around ToRs (3) cheng engages vendor and collects data (4) sam+priya will coordinate rollback if mass disable-offload is needed. Keep updates here.

sam_g: Started drain on rack-12 nodes. Pods are terminating. ETA 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

priya_r: Flipped LB policy to prefer spine routes for lb-internal-us-west. Monitoring for connection churn.

cheng_w: Collected dmesg snippet from node-12-04:```
[  123.456789] e1000e 0000:3b:00.0 eth0: negative sticky open window? RX queues stalled
[  124.000001] tcp: keepalive of syn_recv timed out
```
I attached ethtool/k outputs to the vendor ticket.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-0123 updated: mitigation in progress (traffic reroute + node drains).

alex_m: Early indicators look good — one rack already back to normal after pod migration. Still watching for residual packet loss.

priya_r: Note for follow-up postmortem: evaluate CI kernel deployment gating and add an MTU/offload verification step. Also consider preflight ToR firmware compat test matrix.

sam_g: Will keep drains running until last GPU pod in rack-14 is rescheduled. Ping me if any batch fails.

cheng_w: I'll try a controlled kernel rollback on a single node in rack-13 to confirm causality once drains finish.

alex_m: Thanks all. Filing a short incident report with timeline after we stabilize. :thumbsup:
